close_reason: Extracted verify_cert_signature<V> helper (RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(1)). 23-line block replaced by 1-line call. working_spki update remains in chain_walk per design §6/§7. All 262 tests pass, no behaviour change.
description:
## What

Extract §6.1.3(a)(1) signature verification (lines 2130–2152) into `pub(crate) fn verify_cert_signature<V: SignatureVerifier>(cert: &Certificate, working_spki: &SubjectPublicKeyInfoBorrowed, verifier: &V, index: usize) -> Result<()>`.

## Risk

Low. Pure cryptographic check.

## Notes

- `index: usize` is needed for `Error::SignatureInvalid { index }` construction.
- Do NOT move the `working_spki` update into the helper — that update belongs in `chain_walk` (next-iteration state).

## Acceptance

- New helper.
- chain_walk calls helper at the existing call point.
- Tests + clippy clean.
- No behaviour change.
